title: Lipid scale beyond the triglyceride/HDL ratio does not establish robust cross-cycle fasting-insulin prediction
abstract: In exploratory retrospective NHANES2015–2016 to2017–2018 transfer (1910 source,1864 target adults),adding log(TG*HDL) to flexible log(TG/HDL) and routine covariates changed fasting-weighted log-insulin MSE from 0.260760 to 0.259846;paired gain 0.000914,500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.007823,0.003624]. Source PSU-groupedCV gain was -0.003634. Robust incremental benefit was not established;this is not proof of ratio sufficiency or clinical insulin-resistance prediction. AI authored;author self-checks are not independent peer review. Not untouched confirmation.
